info.title: Hanzo Cloud API
info.description: Package flow is Hanzo Flow: build an agent workflow on a visual canvas, run it, and read every run.

get.summary: Runs reads one workflow's recorded runs: every component build with its result, keyed by component.
get.description:
Runs reads one workflow's recorded runs: every component build with its
result, keyed by component. Ownership is verified first — run records never
cross the org boundary.

parameters.name: workflow
parameters.description:
Workflow is the UUID of the workflow whose run records to read. It rides
the query string.

post.summary: Run executes one of the caller's workflows synchronously: the graph runs in the flow service and the response carries the run's session and outputs.
post.description:
Run executes one of the caller's workflows synchronously: the graph runs in
the flow service and the response carries the run's session and outputs. A
graph whose components fail reports the product's own error. Runs are
bounded by the product's five-minute sync ceiling.

get.summary: Status reports whether the flow service is reachable and which version it runs.
get.description:
Status reports whether the flow service is reachable and which version it
runs. It is the product's own /health and /v1/version composed — an honest
lens for "is the workflow plane up", never a fabricated ok.

get.summary: Workflows lists the caller's workflows, paged.
get.description:
Workflows lists the caller's workflows, paged. The list is scoped
server-side to the org's project — the page can only ever hold the caller's
own workflows.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page is the 1-based page of workflows to return.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Size is how many workflows one page holds (the product caps it at 100).

post.summary: Creates a workflow in the caller's org.
post.description:
Creates a workflow in the caller's org. The org's project id
is pinned server-side from the validated principal — there is no field by
which a caller could place a workflow in another org.

delete.summary: Deletes one of the caller's workflows and its runs.
delete.description:
Deletes one of the caller's workflows and its runs. Ownership
is verified first; a foreign id answers 404 and deletes nothing.

parameters.name: workflow
parameters.description: Workflow is the workflow's UUID, taken from the path.

get.summary: Workflow reads one of the caller's workflows — the full record, graph included.
get.description:
Workflow reads one of the caller's workflows — the full record, graph
included. A workflow outside the caller's org answers 404, indistinguishable
from one that does not exist.

parameters.name: workflow
parameters.description: Workflow is the workflow's UUID, taken from the path.

patch.summary: Patches one of the caller's workflows: name, description, graph, or the locked flag — only the stated fields move.
patch.description:
Patches one of the caller's workflows: name, description,
graph, or the locked flag — only the stated fields move. Ownership is
verified before the patch reaches the product.

parameters.name: workflow
parameters.description: Workflow is the workflow's UUID, taken from the path.

example.description: route tickets to the right queue

data.description:
Data is the workflow graph (the product's nodes/edges document),
verbatim. Omit it to create an empty workflow.

description.description: Description says what the workflow does.

name.description:
Name is the workflow's display name, unique within the org's project
(the product de-duplicates by suffixing).

input.description: Input is the run's chat input value, handed to the graph's input node.

session.description:
Session groups runs into one conversation; the product mints one when
absent and returns it in the response.

tweaks.description:
Tweaks override component fields for this run only (the product's
tweaks document), verbatim.

workflow.description: Workflow is the UUID of the workflow to run.

reachable.description: Reachable is true when the flow service answered its health probe.

version.description: Version is the flow service's own version, present only when reachable.

data.description: Data replaces the workflow graph when present, verbatim.

description.description: Description replaces the description when present.

locked.description: Locked freezes or unfreezes the workflow against edits when present.

name.description: Name renames the workflow when present.

workflow.description: Workflow is the workflow's UUID, taken from the path.
